record.paper_title: Unsolved Problems in Visibility Graphs of Points, Segments and Polygons
record.original_question: Is the problem of recognizing whether a graph is the visibility graph of a simple polygon in NP?

evidence.quote: Open Problem 29 Is the problem of recognizing visibility graphs in NP ?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let P be a simple polygon in the plane with vertex set V(P) = {v_1, ..., v_n}. Two vertices v_i, v_j are said to see each other if the open straight-line segment v_i v_j lies entirely in the interior of P (boundary edges of P are also considered visibility edges). The visibility graph G(P) of P is the graph on vertex set V(P) whose edges are exactly the pairs of vertices that see each other.

The Simple Polygon Visibility Graph Recognition problem is the following decision problem: given a finite simple undirected graph G, determine whether there exists a simple polygon P such that G is isomorphic to the visibility graph G(P).

Question: Does this decision problem belong to the complexity class NP? Equivalently, is there a polynomial-size certificate, verifiable in deterministic polynomial time, witnessing that a given graph G is the visibility graph of some simple polygon?
artifact.status_search_result: The problem remains open. The best known upper bound places visibility graph recognition for simple polygons in PSPACE (specifically, the existential theory of the reals); membership in NP is not established, and the problem is still listed as open in computational geometry problem collections (e.g., TOPP Problem 17) and recent literature on related variants (e.g., pseudo-polygons, polygons with holes).

status_evidence.snippet: Visibility graph recognition is listed as an open problem; complexity unresolved.
status_evidence.claim: The problem is still open in standard open-problem repositories.

status_evidence.title: Recognizing Visibility Graphs of Polygons with Holes and Internal-External Visibility Graphs of Polygons
status_evidence.snippet: The computational complexities of recognizing and reconstructing visibility graphs are widely open; only known result is membership in PSPACE / existential theory of the reals.
status_evidence.claim: Membership in NP is not known; only a PSPACE upper bound is established.

status_evidence.title: On the Visibility Graphs of Pseudo-Polygons: Recognition and Reconstruction
status_evidence.snippet: Recent work on related variants states that the exact complexity class of visibility graph recognition for simple polygons remains unknown.
status_evidence.claim: Status remains unresolved as of recent work.
